page.overview:
Who is Unnamed Spacing Guild Mentat?

Thufir Hawat reported to Duke Leto he had met with an unnamed representative of the Spacing Guild to discuss the possibilities of Surveillance Satellites on Arrakis, however the man indicated the costs would be more orbitant than the Atreides could even imagine. Hawat also clarified the man was a trained Mentat.

While the Guild Mentat remains unnamed in the original book The Dune Encyclopedia the two men bribed by the Fremen to not permit satellites of any kind for Arrakis were named Altenes and Garik of IX. Hawat may have refered to either of the two.
